protocol.name: SmartAccount
protocol.note: The 26 native methods and 15 events below are the complete native ABI. Names, parameter order, manifest types, call flags and safe flags are extracted from the current C# attributes, the native manifest fixture and the native tests. Exactly one execution entry exists: executeUserOp.

authority.rule: For the v4.1 native contract these two documents plus this IDL are the only implementation sources. Where they disagree with any other document, they win.

otherDocuments.reason: Chinese reading edition derived from the IDL, SA-SPEC and the module protocol. It adds no fact and is not an implementation source.
Core protocol NEP draft. Where it disagrees with the IDL and SA-SPEC, the IDL and SA-SPEC win.

nativeOwns: account identity and the stable proxy address
custody, account status, authority epoch, configuration nonce and control revision
module registration, enumeration and code binding metadata
operation nonce channels and namespace collision detection
canonical operation encoding, digest and signing domain
single-route validation and execution, target-frame witness lease and non-reentrancy
resource bounds, atomic rollback and freeze
nativeDoesNotOwn: message signature subjects, message digest domain or message quorum (SigningModule)
guardians, recovery delay and recovery lifecycle (RecoveryModule)
threshold members, weights, quorum or threshold policy state (ThresholdPolicyModule)
governance delay, execution window, conflict detection or action commitment (GovernanceModule)
hook order and planner snapshot storage (HookOrchestratorModule)
asset balances or asset transfers (Neo N3 native assets and NEP-17 contracts)

narrowLandings.validateMember: Accepts leaf validation only from the active composite caller for the exact operation bytes and digest. It stores no member roster, weight or quorum.
narrowLandings.configureModule: Narrow write sink for one module configuration callback. It stores no governance intent or delay policy.
narrowLandings.applyConfigurationActions: Narrow atomic batch write sink. It stores no governance intent or delay policy.

fields.name: defaultMessageAuthorization
fields.v41Effect: compatibility field only; the native message entry is retired

fields.name: nextCursor
fields.semantics: 0 when the page is the last page

methods.name: createAccount
methods.authorization: custody witness; accountId must equal RIPEMD160(SHA256(0xAA524704 || custody || salt)) reversed
effects: writes the 0x51 control record and the 0x11 proxy index
executes 0..16 initial install actions atomically under the registering custody witness
advances the configuration nonce once when actions are present
emits AccountRegistered and the events of the executed actions
guards: custody is not a proxy address or the core
methods.notes: Initial actions are the only configuration path that is not governance-delayed: registration itself is the account's consent.

methods.name: createAccounts
methods.authorization: custody witness
effects: registers 1..64 id/salt pairs in order, each without initial actions
methods.notes: All or nothing: a failing pair rolls the whole batch back.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.notes: Non-faulting for an unknown account: returns the all-zero descriptor with exists=false.

methods.name: getAccountAddress
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.returns: script hash of the fixed proxy verification script; stable across freeze, recovery and reset

methods.name: freezeAccount
methods.authorization: custody witness only, whatever route is pinned; freezing is never governance-delayed
effects: advances authority epoch, configuration nonce and control revision
methods.notes: Emergency path: immediate, never governance-delayed. Custody may always freeze.

methods.name: unfreezeAccount
methods.authorization: governance-only: the account's bound, code-bound governance instance; the custody witness cannot thaw
effects: advances authority epoch, configuration nonce and control revision
methods.notes: Ordinary thaw is a 24 h governance action. Freeze and credential revocation stay immediate.

methods.name: executeUserOp
methods.authorization: permissionless relayer; authority comes from the signed operation
effects: runs the hook bracket and the single target dispatch
guards: authority epoch and configuration nonce equal current values
no open execution for this account
methods.notes: Returns the target call result. A target FAULT rolls the whole invocation back.

methods.name: validateUserOp
methods.authorization: permissionless
effects: none; no nonce is consumed and no state is written
guards: performs the same envelope, epoch, configuration-nonce, deadline, nonce and signature checks as executeUserOp, including a dead channel that previews as a rejection
methods.notes: A rejection is reported as accepted=false, not as a fault, after structural validation succeeds. An exhausted nonce channel is one such rejection: the preview never faults on exhaustion and never writes the sentinel.

methods.name: validateMember
methods.authorization: only the active composite validator instance that is being validated, during the Validation phase
effects: records one leaf approval in engine-local operation state
guards: operationDigest is exactly the digest being validated
operation bytes are byte-identical to the in-flight operation
member is an active, threshold-member-eligible, non-composite validator
methods.notes: Leaf validation only. The core never reads a member roster, weight or quorum here.

methods.name: verify
methods.authorization: the fixed proxy verification script of the account
methods.notes: Admissibility-only witness gate embedded in the fixed proxy verification script. Verification trigger: the caller is the account's proxy and is not the payer, the account exists and is Active, the transaction script carries exactly one executeUserOp(accountId, operation) call for this account, and deadline, authority epoch, configuration nonce and nonce availability hold. It performs no signature check and calls no module, because one witness is capped at 1.5 GAS; authorisation happens once in executeUserOp, so an invalid signature passes the witness and faults at execution. Application trigger: only the proxy frame inside its own target dispatch answers true. It is not a legacy alias.

methods.name: getOperationDigest
methods.authorization: permissionless

methods.name: getNonce
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.returns: (channel << 64) | sequence while the channel is live; once exhausted the raw sentinel 2^64 is returned (never a packed nonce, so it cannot alias the next channel)

methods.name: getNonceSequence
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.returns: the stored 64-bit sequence cursor of the explicit channel (0..2^64-1), or the raw exhaustion sentinel 2^64

methods.name: installModule
methods.authorization: governance-only: the account's bound, code-bound governance instance; creation is the only consent to an initial install
effects: binds code identity and profile digest
guards: callback surface and code binding match
methods.notes: Initial installation during createAccount is the atomic, non-delayed exception.

methods.name: removeModule
methods.authorization: governance-delayed; resetAccount is the only non-governance sweep
effects: deletes the instance and its index row
methods.notes: Removing the last validator requires the built-in operation route to stay open.

methods.name: configureModule
methods.authorization: governance-delayed: the code-bound GovernanceModule submits the mature action
guards: hook order changes only through this path
methods.notes: Narrow write sink. Governance delay, intent identity and conflict detection live in GovernanceModule; this method stores none of them.

methods.name: setBuiltinAuthorization
methods.authorization: governance-delayed: the code-bound GovernanceModule submits the mature action
guards: closing the operation switch requires an installed validator route
methods.notes: The operation switch gates the built-in custody route. The message switch is part of the account record layout and grants no native message authority: the native message entry does not exist and SigningModule is the only message surface.

methods.name: applyConfigurationActions
methods.authorization: governance-delayed; during createAccount the registering custody witness applies the initial group; the seat that just reset an account may apply exactly one install-only group in the same transaction (restricted initialization)
effects: advances the configuration nonce and control revision exactly once
in the restricted reset initialization the reset already advanced both counters, so the landing only saves the restored composition
guards: every ordinary action needs the currently installed, code-bound governance caller
the restricted initialization admits install (1) actions only and must leave at least one installed validator with the governance capability
configure (3) and required-validator (7) actions require the governance caller when governed
faults: and the faults of the contained actions
methods.notes: Narrow batch sink. Governance delay, execution window and conflict policy are GovernanceModule state.

methods.name: revokeModuleCredentials
methods.authorization: custody witness or the code-bound governance caller; immediate
methods.notes: Emergency path: callback-free and immediate. It cannot be interpreted as a grant.

methods.name: resetAccount
methods.authorization: only the account's currently installed, code-bound recovery module, after that module has matured its own record
effects: removes every module instance and emits ModuleInstanceRemoved per instance
deletes every nonce cursor and namespace row
restores Active, default operation/message switches on, requiredValidatorId 0
advances authority epoch, configuration nonce and control revision
keeps the moduleId allocator and the proxy address
opens one engine-local, single-use, install-only initialization for the same seat
guards: caller is the bound recovery instance
newCustody is a valid authority address when nonzero
methods.notes: The core enforces binding and landing only. Guardian quorum, delay and maturity are RecoveryModule state and are checked there before this call. The reset alone leaves no module instance; the same seat may then land exactly one install-only composition through applyConfigurationActions in the same transaction. The transaction has to end with a governance-capable, code-bound validator: a landing that leaves none, a transaction that ends without the landing, or a later call in the same transaction that removes the last one faults the whole transaction and rolls the reset back.

methods.name: getModules
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.notes: moduleType is the manifest string validator, hook or recovery. limit is 1..32; cursor is the last moduleId of the previous page.

methods.name: getModule
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.notes: Returns an empty array for a missing instance.

methods.name: isModuleInstalled
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.notes: additionalContext is accepted and ignored in v4.1; the answer is derived from installed instances of the type.

methods.name: getAuthorizedModuleId
methods.authorization: permissionless
methods.returns: the instance id the core is addressing in this phase, or -1
methods.notes: Valid phases are 1..9; phase 7 (Cleanup) is reserved and never granted.

methods.name: getProtocolInfo
methods.authorization: permissionless

methods.name: getAccountImplementationId
methods.authorization: permissionless

events.name: AccountRegistered
events.note: Registration identity only; no policy state.

events.name: ModuleInstalled
events.note: Legacy indexer feed, emitted beside ModuleInstanceInstalled.

events.name: ModuleRemoved
events.note: Legacy indexer feed, emitted beside ModuleInstanceRemoved.

events.name: UserOpExecuted
events.note: Generic execution metadata; no policy payload.

events.name: BuiltinAuthorizationSet
events.note: defaultMessageAuthorization is reported for record layout compatibility only.

events.name: RequiredValidatorSet
events.note: Mandatory route pointer only. It names one route; it does not carry a member roster, weight or quorum.

retiredEvents.name: RecoveryPolicySet
retiredEvents.reason: Recovery policy and delay are RecoveryModule state. The id is never reused.

retiredEvents.name: ThresholdPolicySet
retiredEvents.reason: Threshold members and quorum are ThresholdPolicyModule state. The id is never reused.

retiredEvents.name: MessageSubjectUpdated
retiredEvents.reason: Message subjects are SigningModule state. The id is never reused.

methods.name: isValidSignature
methods.reason: The native message entry is removed; SigningModule is the only public message-signature entry.

methods.name: setRecoveryPolicy
methods.reason: Recovery policy, guardians and delay are module state.

methods.name: getThresholdPolicy
methods.reason: Threshold roster and quorum are module state.

methods.name: executeRecovery
methods.reason: The module matures the record; the core only lands the reset.

methods.name: setHookOrder
methods.reason: Hook order changes only through a governed module configuration callback.

methods.name: executeUserOps
methods.reason: The kernel exposes exactly one execution entry; a multi-operation envelope is not a native surface and must be split by the caller.

retiredNativeSurface.rule: No alias, rename or additional entry for any of these names may be added to the native ABI.

fields.name: args
fields.domain: at most 64 entries, depth at most 8, serialized at most 4096 bytes

fields.name: hookProofs
fields.domain: 0..8 pairs [hookId, proof], unique strictly ascending hookIds, at most 4096 proof bytes

canonicalOperation.canonicalBytes: NeoVM binary stack-item serialization of the 13-field Array with field 11 replaced by the empty ByteString

userOperation.domain: UTF8("NeoSmartAccount/UserOperation") || U1(4) || U32LE(networkMagic) || coreHash[20] || accountId[20] || U64BE(validatorId) || U64BE(credentialGeneration) || U64BE(authorityEpoch) || U64BE(configurationNonce)
userOperation.coreHash: the actual executing native SmartAccount hash, never a caller-declared value

thresholdMember.owner: ThresholdPolicyModule via the validator member digest

message.note: SigningModule owns the message domain, subject roster and quorum. The native contract defines no message digest and exposes no message entry.

nonce.channel: low 191 bits of SHA256(U1(4) || coreHash || accountId || U64BE(authorityEpoch) || U64BE(validatorId) || U64BE(credentialGeneration) || nonceSubkey)
nonce.namespaceDigest: full 256-bit derivation digest stored at 0x5C for truncation-collision fail-closed detection
nonce.sequence: low 64 bits of the operation nonce
nonce.exhaustionSentinel: 2^64; an internal cursor value outside the encodable sequence domain 0..2^64-1, the channel is dead and never wraps
nonce.collision: a second derivation mapping to an already-used 191-bit channel is rejected with SA_NONCE_CHANNEL_COLLISION

configurationNonce.advance: exactly once per successful configuration call; a batch of 1..16 actions advances it once
configurationNonce.signatureBinding: inside the operation digest; a write signed against a stale nonce faults with SA_CONFIGURATION_NONCE_STALE

governance.rule: install, remove, configure, setBuiltinAuthorization and ordinary unfreeze take effect only through a mature GovernanceModule confirmation. Freeze, credential revocation and the atomic initial actions of createAccount are immediate.

initialActions.note: Creation is the account's consent, so it may install default modules atomically without a governance delay. configure (hook order), setRequiredValidator, remove and setBuiltinAuthorization are governance paths and are rejected in the initial group on the v4.1 target.

codeBinding.record: 0x52 stores contractHash, contractId, updateCounter, SHA256(NEF), SHA256(canonical profile), moduleRevision and credentialGeneration
codeBinding.checked: on install, before and after every module callback, and before commit
codeBinding.comparison: contractId and updateCounter name one deployment slot and revision
codeBinding.drift: any mismatch faults with SA_MODULE_CODE_BINDING_MISMATCH; an address redeploy never inherits authorization

hookOrder.plannerSnapshot: the planHooks reply is validated as a permutation of installed hook ids, frozen in engine-local invocation state and consumed exactly once for the operation
hookOrder.post: reverse planned order over the same frozen set

storage.keyEncoding: 1-byte prefix || raw 20-byte accountId || fixed-width big-endian integer suffixes

schema.status: the only accepted shape; a record of another kind, version or arity fails closed
the only accepted shape; a record of another kind, version or arity fails closed

storage.failClosed: unknown schema version, kind mismatch, unknown arity, truncation, extra fields, non-canonical encoding and out-of-domain values are rejected; no read repairs a record

hardfork.interpretation: one profile only: the tagged records, the closed ABI and the module protocol below are the sole semantics; there is no pre-activation variant
hardfork.irreversible: after activation the state format cannot be downgraded; later releases must keep schema, ABI, native hash and proxy address compatible

reset.caller: the currently installed, code-bound recovery module only
reset.maturity: checked by RecoveryModule before the call; the core checks binding and landing only

postState.moduleInstances: all removed by the reset; the same transaction may reinstall one composition through the restricted install-only initialization, and a transaction that does not end with a governance-capable, code-bound validator faults as a whole and rolls the reset back

restrictedInitialization.context: engine-local, single-use, bound to the reset seat, the account and the post-reset authority epoch
rejected: any custody change beyond the reset's newCustody
restrictedInitialization.landingRule: at least one installed validator has to keep the governance capability with an intact code binding when the script halts: a landing that leaves none, a transaction that ends without the landing, or a later call that removes the last one faults the whole transaction and rolls the reset back
restrictedInitialization.counters: no second advance: epoch, configuration nonce and control revision moved exactly once, in the reset

invalidated: all pending module-local records by unreachable instance identity

p256.v41Change: the implementation must not hash the digest again: contract validators hand the preimage to CryptoLib, whose platform step applies SHA-256 exactly once; the native post-gate calls Crypto.CreateECDsa(key).VerifyHash(D, signature) over the 32-byte digest with no second hash

assets.owner: Neo N3 native assets and NEP-17 contracts
assets.nativeRole: stable proxy address plus authenticated generic dispatch
assets.note: The native contract never owns a token ledger and never mutates NEP-17 balances outside the dispatched target call.

checks: JSON parses and required top-level sections exist
method names are unique and exactly the 26 frozen names
parameter names, manifest types, return types and safe flags match the native manifest fixture for every shared method
call flags match the C# ContractMethod attributes
events are unique with ids {0..10,12,13,16,17} and payloads match the C# ContractEvent attributes
no retired native method name or forbidden alias appears in the method list
